description:
Ideation: objectives that reward emergent pattern while staying stable through the carried hidden state: video as style rather than target, texture/edge statistics, long free-running rollouts that must neither die nor explode, open-endedness/novelty. Push-pull stays the baseline to beat on look.

Research 2026-11-24: DyNCA trains dynamic textures with a style (Gram) loss on appearance plus an optical-flow loss on motion, not per-pixel targets. Cheap variant for our CPU training: Gram or sliced-Wasserstein statistics of a fixed random conv bank (no VGG) between rollout and footage, position-free, next to the existing texture loss. evaluate.py now reports sharpness/contrast to judge it.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Nets trained this way stay sharp and alive over long free-running rollouts instead of drifting to blur
